title: Graphing & Writing Linear Equations
preview: Slope as rate of change, slope-intercept form, writing linear equations from points and graphs, and modeling with linear functions.
description: Students compute slope from multiple representations, write equations in slope-intercept form, and apply linear modeling to real-world rates.

sections.label: 4-1 Slope as a Rate of Change
sections.description: Interpret slope in real contexts: ramp angle, accessibility, rise over run.

sections.label: 4-2 Slope from Two Points
sections.description: Compute slope from any two ordered pairs.

sections.label: 4-3 Slope from a Graph
sections.description: Read slope off a graph, including piecewise rates of change.

warmupRefs.title: Rise over run off the grid

sections.label: 4-4 Slope-Intercept Form
sections.description: Write and interpret equations in y = mx + b form.

sections.label: 4-5 Writing Linear Equations from Two Points
sections.description: Build a linear equation from any two observed points; interpret slope and intercept in context.

sections.label: 4-6 Linear Modeling in the Real World
sections.description: Use linear functions to model and predict real situations.
